reply.text: {"say":"Chest and back, every movement paired as a superset: a press with a row or pulldown each round, compounds first and the isolation pair to finish.","title":"Chest & Back Supersets","days":[{"name":"Chest & Back","exercises":[{"key":"barbell-bench-press","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"A","part":"main","note":"Pause briefly at the chest"},{"key":"barbell-bent-over-row","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"A","part":"main","note":"Flat back, pull to lower ribs"},{"key":"dumbbell-incline-bench-press","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"B","part":"main","note":"30-degree incline"},{"key":"cable-lat-pulldown","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"B","part":"main","note":"Drive elbows down to your sides"},{"key":"machine-chest-press","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"C","part":"main","note":""},{"key":"chest-supported-row-machine","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"C","part":"main","note":"Squeeze shoulder blades together"},{"key":"cable-chest-fly","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"D","part":"main","note":"Soft elbows, hug the stretch"},{"key":"straight-arm-cable-pulldown","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"D","part":"main","note":"Arms long, finish at the hips"}]}],"unmet":[]}
